projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyHint: Each film or production gets its own project here, with its recordings, materials and voice references together.
projects.loglinePlaceholder: One or two sentences about it (optional)
projects.sourceCodeHint: This site runs a modified version of Speakr. Its source code is published under the GNU AGPL v3.

project.adminNote: You see this project because you are an administrator. Its recordings show only where Speakr lets you open them.
project.folderMissing: This project's folder was deleted in the recordings list. Its recordings were kept, outside any folder. A new folder is made when a recording is added here or the project is shared.

details.name: Name
details.notesHint: Anything everyone working on the project should know.
details.hintsHint: Names and words to spell right in every recording of this project. They are settings of the project's folder in the recordings list.
details.hotwordsPlaceholder: Character names, places, the title… separated by commas
details.initialPromptPlaceholder: A sentence or two about what is said in the recordings
details.ownerOnlyHints: Only the project's owner changes the transcription hints.
details.dangerHint: Deletes the project, its materials and voice references, and its folder. The recordings stay, outside any folder, with the people who made them.
details.deleteConfirm: “{{name}}”, its materials and its voice references are deleted. The recordings stay with the people who made them.

recordings.addHint: Audio or video. It is transcribed with the project's hints, in the recordings queue.
recordings.dropHere: Drop audio or video files here
recordings.empty: No recordings in this project yet.
recordings.folderHint: Recordings are kept in the folder “{{folder}}” of the recordings list.

materials.dropHere: Drop files here or choose them
materials.accepted: PDF, PowerPoint (.pptx) and images (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF), up to 30 MB each.
materials.noText: No text could be read from this deck.

voice.intro: Examples of how this project should sound. The writing tools of a later version will match them.
voice.chooseRecording: Choose a recording of this project
voice.noRecordings: No finished recordings in this project yet.
voice.textPlaceholder: Paste a script, a transcript or subtitles. Timestamps and cue numbers of SRT or WebVTT files are removed.

people.intro: People on this list can open the project, its materials and voice references, and every recording in its folder, and can add their own. Only you change the list.
people.introMember: The owner decides who is on this list.
people.sharingOff: Sharing is switched off on this site, so the project cannot be shared. An administrator can switch on internal sharing.
people.scopeGroups: Type part of the username of someone in one of your groups, or a full username or email address.
people.scopeExact: Type the person's full username or email address.
people.removeConfirm: Their recordings in this project leave it, and they no longer see the project or its recordings.

errors.notFound: That project does not exist, or you cannot see it.
errors.ownerOnly: Only the project's owner can do that.
errors.membersOnly: Only the owner and the people on the project's People list can add recordings.
errors.uploaderOrOwner: Only the person who added it, or the project's owner, can delete it.
errors.fieldTooLong: The {{field}} is too long (at most {{max}} characters).
errors.sharingOff: Sharing is switched off on this site.
errors.peopleInvalid: The People list could not be read.
errors.peopleNotAllowed: One of the people could not be found.
errors.tooManyPeople: A project can be shared with at most {{max}} people.
errors.folderHasSubfolders: The project's folder has folders inside it in the recordings list. Move them out, then share again.

errors.type: {{name}}: only PDF, PowerPoint (.pptx) and image (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF) files can be added.
errors.content: {{name}}: the file is not what its name says.
errors.size: {{name}}: the file is larger than {{max}} MB.
errors.missing: The file of this material is missing.

errors.recording: That recording is not in this project, or you cannot open it.
errors.already: That recording is a voice reference already.
errors.empty: There is no text left after removing timestamps and cue numbers.
